office_does: A Kitsap County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; the county's four district judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Gina M. Buskirk, a former Bremerton city prosecutor and defense attorney now on the District Court bench, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County District Court judge; previously a Bremerton city prosecutor, criminal defense attorney and municipal judge pro tem. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Former Bremerton city prosecutor and assistant city attorney, and a public defender and private defense attorney [S1]
Past president of the Kitsap County Bar Association [S1]
Says she uses technology to make the court easier to navigate [S1]
